name: SIGMA - Browser Started with Remote Debugging
author: pH-T (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems) (original rule), Yohan Landji (Cyberlandji) (PB-02 adaptation)
description:
Detects browsers starting with remote-debugging flags, a technique used to drive the browser
over the DevTools Protocol (CDP) - e.g. Network.getAllCookies to dump session cookies. Emulated
as Magpie node 9 (Atomic Red Team T1539 test #4): a powershell script relaunches chrome.exe with
--remote-debugging-port=9222 --profile-directory=Default and issues a CDP cookie dump. Sole
coverage - Defender was silent across this node. Detection keys on the launch (the attempt),
independent of outcome: on this host the theft failed against Chrome 151 (Default-profile DevTools
hardening, exit -1), but the remote-debugging launch is fully captured regardless.
false_positives: Legitimate developer or automated browser-testing use of remote debugging (baseline expected hosts)
